section_title: Pressure vessels, tanks and heat exchangers
text: Pressure equipment shall be designed, manufactured and certified per the Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU (conformity module and category per package specification) with EN 13445 or ASME Section VIII Div. 1 as design code; the code shall be stated on the datasheet and shall not be mixed within a vessel. Vessels with design pressure above 0.5 bar(g) but outside the scope of the directive shall be designed to the same codes.
